name: cassiopeia_muf
description: Web assets for the cassiopeia_muf child template (The Museum of Unbuilt Futures). These entries intentionally reuse the parent's asset names (template.cassiopeia.*) so every dependency on template.active keeps working while the styles resolve to this child's compiled CSS.

assets.name: template.cassiopeia.ltr
assets.description: MUF theme CSS (dark retrofuturist palette, Bootstrap 5.3 dark color mode). Compiled from scss/template.scss.

assets.name: template.cassiopeia.rtl
assets.description: MUF theme CSS for RTL direction.

assets.name: template.cassiopeia_muf.fonts
assets.description: Local OFL fonts (Space Grotesk, Inter, Space Mono). Loaded via @font-face from the compiled CSS; asset kept as a named dependency hook.
